rule: Theory course credit must be between 2.0 and 4.0.
A course must define between 4 and 8 course outcomes.
Every course outcome must map to at least one programme outcome.
A level-4 course must contain at least one outcome at Bloom level 5 or above.
Topic overlap with any existing course must not exceed 40%.
A course whose topics depend on another course must declare it as a prerequisite.
An assessment plan mapping every outcome to at least one assessment component is mandatory.
Contact hours must equal 14 weeks multiplied by the weekly contact hours.
Every programme outcome must be addressed by at least one course in the programme.
Outcome statements must begin with an observable action verb drawn from the Bloom taxonomy.
